extension.summary: LAE (Layered Audio Extension) decoder: LAES lossless masters and LAEY
LAE（分层音频扩展）解码器：LAES 无损母带和 LAEY
extension.description: Plays .lae files: LAES (LAE Lossless) in the WAV, RF64 or FLAC form, and LAEY WAV. A master plays after its SHA-256 has been checked once (remembered per file content). Rename an LAE .flac or .wav file to .lae to play its masters; as .flac or .wav, Kodi plays its CD-compatible core.
播放 .lae 文件：LAES（LAE 无损，WAV、RF64 或 FLAC 形式）和 LAEY WAV。母带先核对一次 SHA-256 再播放（按文件内容记住结果）。把 LAE 的 .flac 或 .wav 改名为 .lae 就能放其中的母带；保持 .flac / .wav 时 Kodi 放它的 CD 兼容核心母带。
